domain_label: Movie Studio — Score Craft & Reel Sound Design (Zimmer-School Techniques to Per-Mood Recipe Cards)
purpose: A method for the score-craft decisions an expert makes when sounding a 3-6 s stitched luxury reel: the sourced Zimmer techniques (theme simplicity and the two-note Batman device, layered ostinato builds, the Dunkirk Shepard-tone endless rise, the Dune no-orchestra hybrid palette, the Interstellar organ-as-metaphor), the honestly split braaam attribution, per-mood recipe cards for intense / suspense / dark-accent / luxury-calm, the one peer-reviewed horror anchor (Blumstein et al. 2010) with the infrasound claim held UNKNOWN, the reel layer stack and bar math, the mono-safe master convention, and the Higgsfield surface's no-standalone-music reality — every claim carried with the grounding file's FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tag, craft conventions stated as conventions, never invented facts.
assumptions: no listening tests, engagement data or platform measurements are supplied; every score is a heuristic prior and every craft claim is quoted with the grounding research file's honesty tag (FACT / ESTIMATE / UNKNOWN), never upgraded

Zimmer technique claims come from the MasterClass chapters and published interviews the research file fetched (sources it numbers 1-15); analyst inferences (e.g. the 'Time' additive-layering framing) stay tagged ESTIMATE

'horror' on this luxury vertical means brief dark-tension accents, not genre horror; the one peer-reviewed anchor is Blumstein, Davitian & Kaye (Biology Letters 2010) and the popular infrasound claim is held UNKNOWN

glossary.definition: Zimmer's 'barest minimum' theme reduction: for Batman he teaches a composer 'can get away with the barest minimum of harmonic and tune', reducing the theme to two notes (a D-F rising minor third in published analyses of the Dark Knight scores; the two-note core is stated in the MasterClass chapter itself) [FACT - MasterClass Themes/Batman chapters via the grounding file].

Short repeating rhythmic figures stacked in layers, each recorded or programmed separately for rhythmic precision, producing 'ever-building excitement'; Zimmer's signature drive device per his Batman MasterClass chapter [FACT]. Craft translation for generated music: add a layer every loop cycle instead of changing the melody [ESTIMATE - craft translation].

The bass-heavy brass blast of the Inception era. Attribution is genuinely split: the film-score braaam is Zimmer's 'Dream Is Collapsing' (staccato throaty brass built outward from the Piaf motif) while the trailer sound was Zack Hemsey's 'Mind Heist' [FACT - published retrospectives]. Consensus recipe: low brass cluster + sub-octave synth doubling + slow attack + long reverb tail, used as punctuation [ESTIMATE].

Overlapping octave-spaced tones where the top voice fades out as the bottom fades in, so the ear hears an endless rise; Zimmer built the Dunkirk score around it - 'the idea of eternity and endlessness... playing a trick on time itself' [FACT - Dunkirk interviews via the grounding file].

Per-note-expressive synthesizers Zimmer used on Dune - Expressive E Osmose and Haken ContinuuM, both running the EaganMatrix engine - because keyboardists want violinist-style vibrato; part of the no-traditional-orchestra palette alongside processed electric cellos/guitars and physical resonators re-amping synths [FACT - Dune coverage via the grounding file].

Noisy screams, non-musical sidebands and other harsh, unpredictable distortions analogous to distressed animal vocalizations; Blumstein, Davitian & Kaye (Biology Letters, 2010) found horror-film soundtracks contain more of them than expected, while drama suppressed noise and used abrupt frequency transitions [FACT - peer-reviewed, the one measured anchor in this KB].

The continuous scene-world layer (-25 to -35 dB under music) that runs UNDER the cuts to glue 3-6 s clips into one place - coastal wind + gulls, room tone + fireplace, distant traffic + chatter; changing the bed means changing the scene [ESTIMATE - standard film-audio layer taxonomy adapted to reels].

Summing a stereo mix to mono to check for phase cancellation. Mandatory here because reels play through phone speakers that are effectively mono, and platform re-encodes can downmix [FACT - observable playback reality]; bass and lead elements stay centered, and spatial width is a headphone bonus only.

Sparse, rubato, close-miked felt piano over slow harmonic rhythm (one chord per 2-4 bars) with maj7/9 voicings - the heritage-luxury palette core; a craft/industry convention for 'expensive' warmth, not a measured finding [ESTIMATE - the grounding file fetched no luxury-sound study].

The media role by which an externally sourced track can condition a video generation on the Higgsfield surface; accepted by seedance_2_0, seedance_2_0_mini, wan2_7 and wan2_6 [FACT - live MCP surface enumeration 2026-07-03]. One of the three lanes for scored audio, since the surface has no standalone music/SFX model.

nodes.definition: Anchor the melodic doctrine: in his MasterClass chapters on themes, Zimmer teaches that simplicity is his primary tool for a memorable theme - a tune of very few notes 'played with a full heart' - and that for Batman a composer 'can get away with the barest minimum of harmonic and tune', reducing the theme to a two-note device (a D-F rising minor third in published analyses of the Dark Knight scores; the two-note core is stated in the MasterClass chapter itself) [FACT - MasterClass Themes and Batman chapters]. nodes.definition: Build drive the Zimmer way: layered ostinatos - short repeating rhythmic figures stacked in layers, each recorded or programmed separately for rhythmic precision, creating 'ever-building excitement' (his Batman MasterClass chapter describes recording ostinato patterns separately for precise rhythm) [FACT - MasterClass via the grounding file]. This is the engine of the intense card: the melody (if any) stays minimal per the theme doctrine while density and register stacking do the escalation work.

nodes.definition: Use the Shepard tone as the continuous-escalation device. nodes.definition: Compose the go/no-go verdict every score brief must pass before it ships: (1) the scene mood maps to exactly one recipe card (A intense, B suspense, C dark accent within the cap, D/E luxury, F VO) with the card's structural rules intact; (2) attribution honesty holds - the braaam is dual-credited, the watch detail stays ESTIMATE, conventions stay tagged conventions, the infrasound and low-end-EQ UNKNOWNs stay blocked; (3) the sourcing lane is confirmed against the Higgsfield reality (native in-video audio, audio_references, or external in post) and generate_audio is never asked for music; (4) because current AI music tools are strong at loopable mood beds and genre pastiche but weak at precise hit-point scoring [ESTIMATE - medium confidence, from the grounding file], cut-sync is achieved by EDITING TO THE MUSIC rather than scoring to picture; (5) bar math is locked before cutting; (6) the master passes the mono-safe check with convention-tagged targets. A brief that fails any honesty gate or lacks a sourcing lane is a no-go until fixed.

included: the six-gate verdict composing cards, honesty, sourcing, edit-to-music, bar math and master checks
the no-go conditions
the edit-to-the-music rule with its ESTIMATE tag
excluded: licensing clearance (its own specialist)
per-scene visual direction (other KBs)

pros.claim: A single verdict keeps craft, honesty and platform reality from being satisfied separately while the shipped reel violates one of them
pros.example: catching a brief that has a beautiful Card B spec but no sourcing lane and would have died at the generate_audio refusal

cons.claim: Six gates add process weight to a fast-turnaround reel pipeline and can over-formalize trivial reels
cons.example: a 10-second ambient loop reel forced through the full verdict when only two gates meaningfully apply

failure_modes: shipping a brief with an unconfirmed sourcing lane
letting a convention or contested claim through untagged because the creative was strong
acceptance_tests: the verdict names the chosen card, shows the honesty tags intact (dual braaam credit, held UNKNOWNs), names the sourcing lane, states edit-to-the-music, and attaches the bar-math and mono-safe checks
revisit_triggers: AI music tools gain reliable hit-point scoring and gate (4) inverts
the surface lane map changes
an honesty slip ships and the gate order needs hardening

base.update_signal: a tooling capability shift, surface change, or shipped honesty slip rewrites the verdict

the braaam is a primary carrier of the sub-bass emphasis whose numeric EQ remains the named UNKNOWN
the drone floors of the hybrid palette are the other documented locus of low-end weight the UNKNOWN node governs
accelerating ostinati are a core member of the intense device kit, so the build grammar must be fixed first
the quiet-tension quote from the Dunkirk sourcing is the intense kit's only FACT anchor
Shepard risers are a listed suspense device and Dunkirk supplies the kit's documented ticking anchor
the UNKNOWN node reroutes blocked infrasound language to the nonlinear-features anchor, so the anchor must exist first

Card A composes the intense device kit into an executable brief, so the kit precedes the card
Card A's climax hit is the braaam recipe with its punctuation rule and dual attribution

Card C's harsh-noise device class is licensed by the Blumstein finding, its only evidence-based element
Cards D/E instantiate the heritage/sleek sub-moods the conventions node defines
Card F runs a Card D or E bed under the VO, so the luxury cards precede the VO card
Card F applies the question-answer theme grammar across media: the quote poses, the score answers
Card F's VO rides the surface's TTS tools (seed_audio, text2speech_v2) while its bed must come from a music lane
the bar math times the transition-on-cut-frame / downbeat-with-new-shot law the stack defines

the verdict's card gate requires Card A's structural rules intact for intense scenes
the verdict's card gate requires Card B's resolve-on-reveal rule intact for tease scenes
the verdict enforces Card C's roughly-30% cap and its Blumstein-not-infrasound rationale
the verdict's card gate covers the two luxury cards that carry most of the vertical's volume

gate (5) of the verdict is bar math locked before cutting
gate (6) of the verdict is the mono-safe master check with convention-tagged targets

the Shepard device sells one continuous unbroken rise while the bar grid segments time into countable cut units - seamlessness versus grid
edges.resolution_rule: the grid governs the cuts and the riser glues across them: run the Shepard riser over the bar-locked cut plan rather than abandoning the grid for seamlessness, and land its resolution on a grid downbeat

edges.why_related: the intense kit escalates loudness and density while the luxury grammar demands unhurried restraint - the vertical's two poles
edges.resolution_rule: mood assignment is per scene and the luxury conventions are the vertical's default: intensity is reserved for explicitly intense scenes (supercar, gym) and even there the master stays restrained rather than loudness-war hot

edges.why_related: dark-accent textures directly contradict the aspirational-calm contract the luxury cards exist to keep
edges.resolution_rule: the luxury contract wins by volume: dark accents stay within roughly 30% of a reel and always cut back to calm, and a reel that cannot honor the cap drops Card C entirely

edges.why_related: the Zimmer-school sub-bass weight pulls toward heavy low end while phone-speaker mono playback reproduces almost none of it
edges.resolution_rule: the delivery reality wins: bass stays centered and mono-checked, sub weight is designed as headphone depth that degrades gracefully, and no invented Hz doctrine may override the fold-down check

edges.why_related: Card A's brief assumes a music generator while the surface has no standalone music model and generate_audio must decline music
edges.resolution_rule: the surface reality wins at execution: the card's brief routes to an external music lane or audio_references conditioning, never to generate_audio, and native in-video audio is accepted only when card fidelity is expendable

edges.why_related: the dark card is where the unfetched infrasound claim is most tempting as a rationale for sub-heavy dread
edges.resolution_rule: the UNKNOWN blocker wins: Card C's rationale language uses only the Blumstein nonlinear-features anchor, and any sub-20 Hz psychological claim is struck until a source is actually fetched

edges.why_related: both are continuous-escalation engines built from stacked repeating material - added loop layers in one, octave-staggered fades in the other
the barest-minimum theme doctrine and felt-piano minimalism share the same restraint aesthetic: fewer notes carrying more weight
Card B's resolve-on-the-reveal-frame rule is only executable if the reveal frame sits on the bar grid the math derives
Card A's 'deep sub pulses' language is bounded by the UNKNOWN: it may specify palette weight but never a numeric 'Zimmer curve'

conflict_axes.name: escalation_vs_restraint
conflict_axes.description: The intense kit escalates density and loudness while the luxury vertical's core grammar is unhurried restraint; every scene assignment negotiates this axis.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: restraint is the vertical default; escalation is scene-scoped (supercar, gym) and even intense masters avoid loudness-war levels

conflict_axes.name: dark_seasoning_vs_aspirational_calm
conflict_axes.description: Dark-accent textures buy contrast but directly threaten the aspirational contract; the roughly-30% cap is the negotiated boundary.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: cap dark accents at roughly 30% of a reel and always cut back to calm; drop Card C when the cap cannot hold

conflict_axes.name: continuous_rise_vs_bar_grid
conflict_axes.description: The Shepard rise sells seamless unbroken time while the stitched-reel grammar cuts on a countable bar grid.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the grid governs cuts, the riser glues across them; land the riser's resolution on a grid downbeat

conflict_axes.name: sub_bass_weight_vs_phone_speaker_reality
conflict_axes.description: Zimmer-school sub-bass emphasis pulls the mix down-spectrum while default phone-speaker playback reproduces little of it and mono fold-down punishes wide bass.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: bass centered and mono-checked; sub weight designed as headphone depth that degrades gracefully

conflict_axes.name: spatial_impression_vs_mono_baseline
conflict_axes.description: Binaural and width tricks deliver a real headphone impression but there is no Atmos lane on Reels and speakers collapse to mono.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: 3D is a headphone bonus over a mono-safe baseline; no spatial trick carries load-bearing information

conflict_axes.name: sole_zimmer_credit_vs_shared_attribution
conflict_axes.description: The convenient story credits the braaam to Zimmer alone; the fetched record splits it between 'Dream Is Collapsing' (film) and Hemsey's 'Mind Heist' (trailer).
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always dual-credit; the grounding file's rule is explicit - do not credit the braaam solely to Zimmer

conflict_axes.name: peer_reviewed_anchor_vs_unfetched_folklore
conflict_axes.description: Horror device language can rest on the one fetched study (Blumstein 2010) or on popular unfetched claims like infrasound; only one is citable.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: route all dark-accent rationale to the nonlinear-features anchor; hold infrasound at UNKNOWN, neither asserted nor debunked

conflict_axes.name: on_surface_generation_vs_external_sourcing
conflict_axes.description: Executing on the Higgsfield surface means native in-video audio with little card control; card fidelity requires audio_references or external music the surface cannot generate.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: pick the lane per reel: native audio when fidelity is expendable, audio_references or external post when a card's structure must survive; never ask generate_audio for music

conflict_axes.name: hit_point_scoring_vs_edit_to_music
conflict_axes.description: Cards specify frame-exact events (resolve on reveal, beat on entrance) while current AI music tools are weak at precise hit-point scoring and strong at loopable beds.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: achieve cut-sync by editing to the music: generate the bed first, derive the grid, place cuts and reveals on its downbeats

edge_cases.description: A brief, deck or caption credits the braaam solely to Zimmer
edge_cases.trigger: the Inception association is written up without the trailer/film split
edge_cases.mitigation: correct to the dual attribution: film-score braaam in Zimmer's 'Dream Is Collapsing', trailer era shaped by Zack Hemsey's 'Mind Heist'

edge_cases.description: A mix template ships specific Hz boosts labeled as a 'Zimmer low-end curve'
edge_cases.trigger: an engineer wants concrete numbers and doctrine-izes convention
edge_cases.mitigation: strip the attribution: sub-bass emphasis is analyst-documented, numeric curves are engineering convention, and the UNKNOWN stays named

edge_cases.description: A dark-accent rationale claims sub-20 Hz infrasound induces dread
edge_cases.trigger: client-facing language reaches for the popular infrasound claim
edge_cases.mitigation: replace with the Blumstein 2010 nonlinear-features anchor; the infrasound claim stays UNKNOWN with no source fetched

edge_cases.description: The pipeline prompts Higgsfield generate_audio for a music bed or SFX
edge_cases.trigger: an operator assumes the audio tool covers music
edge_cases.mitigation: generate_audio is speech-only and declines music/SFX by design; route to native in-video audio, audio_references (seedance_2_0/mini, wan2_7, wan2_6), or external music in post

edge_cases.description: A load-bearing lead or hook lives in the stereo sides and vanishes on a phone speaker
edge_cases.trigger: the mix is approved on studio monitors without a mono fold-down
edge_cases.mitigation: mono fold-down check before publish; bass and lead elements centered; width and binaural content carry no load-bearing information

edge_cases.description: A luxury reel's dark accent stretches past the cap and the reel reads as a thriller teaser
edge_cases.trigger: the drama of Card C textures seduces the edit past roughly 30% of runtime
edge_cases.mitigation: enforce the cap at layout time and end on the cut-to-calm; if the scene truly needs more darkness it is off-vertical

edge_cases.description: The chosen track's bar length does not divide the clip lengths and every cut lands off-beat
edge_cases.trigger: music was picked after the cut, or BPM was chosen without the arithmetic
edge_cases.mitigation: choose BPM so bar (or half-bar) length divides the 3-6 s clip lengths - at 120 BPM a bar is 2.0 s - and re-derive the grid whenever clip durations change

edge_cases.description: An operator regenerates a cue repeatedly trying to land a resolution chord on a fixed reveal frame
edge_cases.trigger: score-to-picture is attempted with an AI tool weak at hit-point scoring
edge_cases.mitigation: invert the workflow: generate the bed first, then edit the reveal onto the music's own resolution point (edit-to-the-music)

edge_cases.description: Card B's harmony resolves mid-reel, before the reveal frame
edge_cases.trigger: a generated cue carries an unrequested cadence or the edit drifts off the timing contract
edge_cases.mitigation: audition for stasis violations before the edit and keep the single resolution chord on the reveal frame only

edge_cases.description: The Nolan-watch ticking detail is quoted as verbatim-fetched fact in production notes
edge_cases.trigger: a vivid secondary-coverage detail gets upgraded during retelling
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the split: ticking-pulse-as-suspense is the documented load-bearing fact; the watch-recording detail stays ESTIMATE from secondary coverage

edge_cases.description: The climax hit lands without the preceding silence and reads flat
edge_cases.trigger: the 0.5-1 s silence-before-the-hit is trimmed for pace
edge_cases.mitigation: protect the silence gap in the edit; the convention's whole mechanism is contrast before impact

edge_cases.description: A master is pushed well above the -14 LUFS convention and the platform transcode clips or gain-rides it
edge_cases.trigger: loudness-war instinct meets a platform with no published normalization target
edge_cases.mitigation: master to ~-14 LUFS / -1 dBTP as working convention (tagged as such - Instagram publishes no spec and its engineering post was 403-blocked) and re-check after any re-render

workflow.action: Anchor the Zimmer technique kit with its sourcing intact
workflow.description: State theme simplicity with the two-note Batman device and question-answer grammar, plus the layered-ostinato build translation
workflow.artifact: technique kit note with FACT/ESTIMATE tags
workflow.gate: the two-note device, question-answer framing and add-layers-on-a-loop translation are stated with correct tags

workflow.action: Pin the honesty ledger for the contested and unknown items
workflow.description: Record the braaam dual attribution, the low-end-EQ UNKNOWN, the infrasound UNKNOWN, and the watch-detail ESTIMATE
workflow.gate: dual braaam credit stated, both UNKNOWNs named with blockers, no convention upgraded to fact

workflow.action: Fix the mood grammars per scene type
workflow.description: State the intense, suspense, dark-accent and luxury-calm device kits with the Blumstein anchor and all convention tags
workflow.gate: each kit carries its evidence grade; the sole FACT anchors (Zimmer quiet-tension quote, Blumstein 2010, Dunkirk ticking) are correctly placed

workflow.action: Commit the signature instrument per persona
workflow.description: Apply the instrument-as-metaphor rule: one recurring signature sound per persona as sonic brand identity
workflow.gate: one signature instrument named per persona, rule tagged as design inference from the Interstellar sourcing

workflow.action: Draft the recipe-card brief for the scene
workflow.description: Select Card A/B/C/D/E/F per scene mood and instantiate its tempo, palette, structure, SFX and brief text
workflow.gate: exactly one card selected with structural rules intact (layer schedule, resolve-on-reveal, roughly-30% cap, no-drums heritage, beat-on-entrance)

workflow.action: Apply the VO grammar if the reel carries a quote
workflow.description: Set the bed level, side-chain ducking, final-3 s swell and CTA ending; route VO to surface TTS
workflow.gate: bed at -18 to -12 dB ducked, swell after the last word, no real-person voice evocation

workflow.action: Build the five-layer stack for the reel
workflow.description: Lay the ambience bed, spot FX, cut-frame transitions, music and voice with the level discipline
workflow.gate: one bed per scene world, transition SFX on cut frames, music downbeats with new shots

workflow.action: Lock the bar math before any cut
workflow.description: Choose BPM so bar or half-bar length divides the clip lengths; derive the cut grid
workflow.gate: every clip length is a whole or half number of bars at the chosen BPM

workflow.action: Confirm the audio sourcing lane against the Higgsfield surface
workflow.description: Pick native in-video audio, audio_references conditioning, or external music in post; never generate_audio for music
workflow.gate: a lane is named with the enumerated model flags quoted correctly; no music request targets generate_audio

workflow.action: Master mono-safe to the convention-tagged targets
workflow.description: Fold to mono, center bass and leads, master ~-14 LUFS / -1 dBTP, upload AAC >=256 kbps 48 kHz stereo
workflow.gate: mono fold-down passes; targets carried as convention, not claimed platform spec; spatial content non-load-bearing

workflow.description: Check card fit, honesty tags, sourcing lane, edit-to-the-music, bar math and master before the brief ships
workflow.gate: all six gates pass or the brief is a no-go with the failing gate named

dominance_rules.rule: The honesty tag dominates any craft claim's persuasiveness
dominance_rules.rationale: the grounding file carries FACT/ESTIMATE/UNKNOWN tags precisely so conventions and contested claims never harden into facts in production materials
dominance_rules.trigger: a brief, deck or KB answer states a scoring claim
dominance_rules.action: carry the tag with the claim; conventions stay conventions, the two UNKNOWNs stay named, contested attributions stay split

dominance_rules.rule: Shared braaam attribution dominates the clean single-author story
dominance_rules.rationale: the fetched record splits the braaam between Zimmer's 'Dream Is Collapsing' (film) and Hemsey's 'Mind Heist' (trailer), and the grounding file's rule is explicit
dominance_rules.trigger: the braaam is mentioned in any output
dominance_rules.action: dual-credit every time; never credit the braaam solely to Zimmer

dominance_rules.rule: The mono-safe baseline dominates every spatial and low-end ambition
dominance_rules.rationale: reels play on effectively mono phone speakers and re-encodes can downmix, so anything that dies in mono was never delivered
dominance_rules.trigger: a mix uses width, binaural rendering or heavy sub weight
dominance_rules.action: pass the mono fold-down with bass and leads centered before any spatial or sub decision is kept

dominance_rules.rule: The roughly-30% dark-seasoning cap dominates dramatic ambition on this vertical
dominance_rules.rationale: darkness is seasoning for a luxury brand; past the cap the reel reads as genre horror and breaks the aspirational contract
dominance_rules.trigger: Card C textures are proposed for a reel
dominance_rules.action: hold the accent to roughly 30% of runtime with a cut back to calm, or drop the card

dominance_rules.rule: The Blumstein nonlinear-features anchor dominates infrasound folklore for dark-accent rationale
dominance_rules.rationale: Blumstein et al. 2010 is the one peer-reviewed finding fetched; the infrasound claim has no fetched source and is held UNKNOWN
dominance_rules.trigger: a rationale for harsh or dark sound is written
dominance_rules.action: cite the nonlinear-features finding; strike any sub-20 Hz psychological claim until a source is fetched

dominance_rules.rule: Edit-to-the-music dominates score-to-picture under current AI tooling
dominance_rules.rationale: the grounding file assesses AI music tools as strong at loopable beds and weak at frame-exact hit points
dominance_rules.trigger: a card demands a frame-exact musical event (reveal resolve, entrance beat)
dominance_rules.action: generate the bed first, derive its grid, and move the cut to the music's event rather than regenerating music at the frame

dominance_rules.rule: The surface's speech-only reality dominates any brief's generation plan
dominance_rules.rationale: Higgsfield's generate_audio declines music/SFX by design and the game-pipeline audio models are fenced off
dominance_rules.trigger: a score brief needs rendering into actual audio
dominance_rules.action: route via native in-video audio, audio_references, or external music in post; never target generate_audio with music

dominance_rules.rule: The downbeat-on-cut grammar dominates ad-hoc clip placement
dominance_rules.rationale: bar-locked cuts are what make stitched 3-6 s clips read as one intentional film
dominance_rules.trigger: clips are being sequenced against a track
dominance_rules.action: lock BPM and grid first (bar divides clip length), then place transition SFX on cut frames and downbeats with new shots

dominance_rules.rule: Silence-before-the-hit dominates wall-to-wall loudness at climaxes
dominance_rules.rationale: the convention's mechanism is contrast: 0.5-1 s of silence multiplies the perceived force of the impact
dominance_rules.trigger: a climax hit (braaam, sub drop) is being placed
dominance_rules.action: protect the preceding silence gap in both music and SFX layers rather than filling it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Choose the track BPM (bar divides clip length) before cutting any clip
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-cutting an entire reel because every cut landed off-grid against music chosen later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Commit each persona's signature instrument before scoring the first reel
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a brand-wide re-score after five reels ship with five unrelated sonic identities

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the sourcing lane (native / audio_references / external) before writing the score brief
anti_rework_rules.prevents: briefs authored for a music generator the Higgsfield surface does not have, discovered at the generate_audio refusal

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the honesty tags into the brief at authoring time, not at review
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a late honesty audit unwinding shipped decks that credited the braaam to one author or cited infrasound as fact

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lock the reveal frame onto the bar grid before rendering Card B's cue
anti_rework_rules.prevents: repeated cue regenerations chasing a resolution chord that the edit could have moved to in one trim

anti_rework_rules.rule: Cap the dark accent at layout time (roughly 30%), not in the final review
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-editing a finished luxury reel that drifted into thriller-teaser territory

anti_rework_rules.rule: Run the mono fold-down on the first bounce, not the last
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a full re-mix after the publish-day discovery that the lead element cancels on phone speakers

anti_rework_rules.rule: Master to the convention targets (~-14 LUFS / -1 dBTP) from the first export
anti_rework_rules.prevents: re-mastering after platform transcode clipping, with the reminder that the target is convention because no spec is published

iteration_protocol.trigger: Instagram publishes an official loudness/codec spec, or the 403-blocked engineering post becomes fetchable
iteration_protocol.action: replace the convention-tagged targets with the published values and upgrade the pipeline claims from ESTIMATE

iteration_protocol.trigger: the Higgsfield surface adds a standalone music/SFX model or changes an audio flag or role
iteration_protocol.action: re-enumerate the surface, rewrite the three-lane map, and re-route the recipe cards' sourcing

iteration_protocol.trigger: a source substantiating or refuting the infrasound-unease claim is actually fetched
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the UNKNOWN in the direction the source supports and update the dark-accent rationale language

iteration_protocol.trigger: a primary source publishes numeric Zimmer low-end engineering detail
iteration_protocol.action: resolve the low-end-EQ UNKNOWN and re-tag the affected mix guidance

iteration_protocol.trigger: AI music tools gain reliable frame-exact hit-point scoring
iteration_protocol.action: invert the edit-to-the-music rule where score-to-picture is now cheaper and update Cards B/E timing contracts

iteration_protocol.trigger: the MasterClass chapters or the Dunkirk/Dune/Interstellar interviews are re-fetched and a quote or claim diverges from the grounding file
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the technique nodes against the fetched text and correct any drifted quote or attribution

iteration_protocol.trigger: a measured luxury-sound perception study is fetched
iteration_protocol.action: upgrade the luxury conventions' evidentiary tags and re-weight the palette and the unhurried rule

iteration_protocol.trigger: a shipped reel fails in the field (mono cancellation, off-beat cuts, dark-drift brand feedback)
iteration_protocol.action: trace the failure to the violated gate, harden that workflow step, and re-run the verdict on queued briefs

priority_rationale: The Zimmer technique nodes come first because they are the sourced craft vocabulary every downstream choice quotes (theme simplicity, ostinato build, braaam with its split attribution, Shepard rise, hybrid palette, signature instrument), with the two honesty blockers (low-end-EQ UNKNOWN, infrasound UNKNOWN) pinned beside them; the mood grammars then organize that vocabulary per scene type with the one peer-reviewed anchor placed; the recipe cards compose grammar into executable briefs; the delivery nodes (layer stack, bar math, mono-safe master) make the briefs survive stitched 3-6 s cuts and phone-speaker playback; the Higgsfield surface node grounds execution in what the platform can actually render; and the go/no-go verdict comes last because it composes cards, honesty, sourcing, timing and mastering into one shippable decision.
